description_zh:
把 AI Passport 变成随身宝可梦冒险。听完大木博士的介绍，从御三家或皮卡丘中选择伙伴，从森林、山洞、海边和电站出发，随徽章开放海岛、高塔、火山、龙谷等八个新地区，寻找前 151 只宝可梦。

宣传片（约 3 分 43 秒，含赤红片段）：
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/reports/video/pokewalk-story-red-2026-09-09/pokewalk-story-v3.mp4
这是 9 月 9 日录制的故事版，包含开局、捕获、养成与挑战；尚未包含秘境和新增地区，按键与部分规则以当前版本为准。

掌握投球时机，收集不同伙伴与闪光形态，组建六人队伍。照料影响成长和探索收益，进化、图鉴与成就还能带来道具奖励。十二位地图训练家可重复切磋，低等级队员有经验追赶，随后挑战道馆、四天王、冠军与赤红。带上自己培养的伙伴，挑战森林、八个地区主题秘境和冠军远征，选择局内强化、寻找稀有伙伴。

战斗自动从已学招式中出招，技能随成长解锁，无需管理 PP 或遗忘技能。配有像素动画、场景音乐、音量与静音控制，支持自动熄屏。统一使用体能安排日常冒险，约 1 小时从零恢复满。

探索根据周边 Wi-Fi 环境变化判断移动，不是真实计步。当前支持 191 种招式，并非完整金银复刻。非官方同人项目，名称、画面与音乐的素材来源见源码说明。

每枚徽章解锁一项新探索活动。随机追踪会轮换目标，收集图鉴、闪光伙伴和进化道具；带上自己的伙伴挑战森林秘境，组合强化并逐段获得奖励，通关后还能发现一只可捕获伙伴。

菜单与照料页可显示电量；选项支持电量显示开关、亮度、音量、静音与 Wi-Fi 校时；校时后可补回关机期间的体能。网页与离线工具支持 USB 备份、确认导入，方便保存进度。同一设备可导入新版固件支持的旧存档；更新前请备份，跨版本导入需同时更新设备与存档工具。

存档管理：https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/
完整历次更新：https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/tree/main/reports

八张新地图各有三条不同伙伴池的探索方向，选择时可查看代表伙伴和等级范围，另有轮换追踪、深层调查和地区研究；主题秘境提供不同首领、首通奖励及挑战档。它们共用八节点流程，尚未加入地图专属机关或长剧情。


探索分支现在有轮换访客，照料可提高经验、特殊发现和捕获容错。连胜探索提升闪光机会，累计时长记录陪伴。完整攻略：https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/guide/
description_en:
Turn AI Passport into a pocket Pokémon adventure. Meet Professor Oak, choose a starter or Pikachu, and explore four starting areas plus eight regions unlocked by your progress, with the same first 151 Pokémon. Catch shinies, raise a party of six and earn evolution items through achievements. Train against twelve route opponents, then challenge Gyms, the Elite Four, the Champion and Red, or take your own partners into the Forest dungeon, eight themed dungeons and the Champion Expedition.

Battles automatically choose from learned moves, with no PP or forgetting. Pixel animation, scene music, volume, mute and screen sleep are included. Movement is inferred from Wi-Fi changes, not step counting. There are 191 moves; this is not a complete Gold/Silver recreation. This unofficial fan project credits artwork, music and naming sources in the repository.

Story video (3m43s, including Red):
https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/blob/main/reports/video/pokewalk-story-red-2026-09-09/pokewalk-story-v3.mp4
Recorded September 9, before the dungeons and new regions. Current controls and rules differ in places.

Each badge unlocks another exploration activity. Rotating tracking targets, shinies and evolution items give you more to collect. Take your own partners through the Forest dungeon, combine upgrades and earn rewards along the way, and discover a capturable partner after clearing the final boss.

Menu and Care can show the battery level. Options includes a battery-display toggle, brightness, volume, mute and Wi-Fi time sync for powered-off stamina recovery. Online and offline USB tools back up saves and import them after device confirmation. You can import older saves on the same device when supported by the installed firmware. Back up before updating, and update both the device and save tool for cross-version import.

Save manager: https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/
Full update history: https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/tree/main/reports

New regions offer three exploration directions, rotating targets, deeper investigation and research. Themes have different bosses, first-clear rewards and challenge difficulty. They share an eight-node structure; bespoke map puzzles and long story events are not included.

Each new region has three distinct habitats. Preview example partners and the encounter level range before choosing a trail. New-region encounter levels come from that region’s range; deeper exploration uses its upper half.


Meet rotating trail visitors, use care to improve experience, special discoveries and capture timing, and build exploration chains for better shiny odds. Cumulative playtime records your journey. Full guide: https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/guide/
instructions_zh:
开始冒险
首次开机听完大木博士介绍，按画面提示从妙蛙种子、小火龙、杰尼龟或皮卡丘中选择伙伴。已有存档会继续原进度。游戏可离线游玩，不需要先配网。

按键
A 上一项，B 下一项，C 确认；长按 B 返回，长按 C 熄屏。无操作约 60 秒自动熄屏，按任意功能键唤醒，唤醒的第一下不会触发页面操作。捕获时 A/B 切换球，C 在合适时机投球；部分页面操作以屏幕提示为准。

从哪里开始
主页用 A/B 选择照料、菜单或遭遇，再按 C。菜单可以进入图鉴、队伍、道具、照料、挑战、选项、成就、探索与秘境。建议先去「探索」选择路线寻找伙伴，获得遭遇后选择捕获或战斗。战斗自动从已学招式出招，无需管理 PP。玩耍需要至少 5 点体能；体能不足仍可用树果喂食。成长到进化条件后，设为队首并到「照料 → 进化」确认。

体能与挑战
体能上限 100，约 1 小时恢复满。普通探索与路线训练家切磋消耗 5 点；道馆、强化重赛和赤红消耗 10 点；四天王与冠军整轮消耗 20 点。森林秘境选择自己的 1～3 只伙伴，新开局消耗 20 点，继续旅程不重复收费；场间保留局内 HP 和异常，已结算奖励不会因失败或结束丢失。

电量显示
菜单和照料页的宝可梦名字右侧显示电量，20% 及以下变红。在「菜单 → 选项 → 电量显示」按 C 开关，重启后保留选择。

成就与秘境伙伴
背包道具已满仍可领取成就，奖励补到上限，超出部分不增加。森林秘境最终首领通关结算后，会把一只可捕获伙伴放入「遭遇」；返回遭遇列表选择它，再正常投球捕获。列表最多五只，满时替换最早一只。

声音与亮度
「菜单 → 选项」可切换静音、调整音量和亮度。音量或亮度按 C 进入调整，A 加、B 减，C 完成；亮度范围 10%–100%。设置重启后保留。调音量不会自动解除静音。

Wi-Fi 校时与关机体能
进入「菜单 → 选项 → Wi-Fi校时」，按 C 开启配网。手机连接设备画面显示的 PW- 开头临时热点，密码也显示在设备上；保持连接，即使手机提示此热点无法上网。浏览器打开 http://192.168.4.1，填写可用的 2.4GHz 家庭 Wi-Fi 或另一台设备提供的热点名称和密码，点击「连接并保存」。回到设备查看状态，显示「时间已同步」即成功。
配网热点约 5 分钟自动关闭；C 可关闭或重新开启，长按 B 返回也会关闭。连接失败检查名称、密码和网络，再重新开启配网；非配网画面按 A 重试联网校时。成功联网后保存网络，下次开机自动连接。首次校时建立时间基准，之后开机校时才能补回关机期间的体能；断网仍可游玩。

备份与导入
桌面 Chrome / Edge 打开 https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/，选择私人备份目录，用 USB 数据线连接设备并授权串口，关闭占用串口的日志工具。设备进入「菜单 → 选项 → 备份存档」，按 C；等网页文件保存、设备提示完成。文件保存在自己的电脑，不上传。
导入时先在设备打开「选项 → 导入存档」，网页选择 .pksave 文件并请求导入。设备默认取消，需选择确认覆盖并按 C；系统先备份当前进度，再导入并重启，重新连接网页核对结果。导入要求同一设备，且当前固件支持备份的存档格式。本版可读取 V5～V20 旧存档，不再要求固件构建完全相同；不支持将较新的存档导入不认识该格式的旧固件。旧 .pksave 文件无需转换或修改。
离线使用可在网页下载工具 ZIP，解压后用 Python 3.8 或以上运行 python3 server.py（Windows 可用 py -3 server.py），再打开 http://localhost:8767/。跨版本导入请先更新设备固件，并刷新网页；离线用户请重新下载工具 ZIP。只有更新网页、设备仍用旧固件时，仍可能提示不兼容。开发命令行 restore.py 仍限同一构建，跨版本请用网页或离线网页工具。

牛奶回复
训练家、道馆与联盟对战的「战术 → 牛奶回复」现在回复最大 HP 的一半（向上取整），至少 50 HP，不超过满血，并解除异常状态。使用占一回合，倒下的伙伴不能使用；照料时仍是饱食 +20、心情 +10。

更新前请先备份。社区完整安装可能覆盖存档，请保留原备份文件；导入兼容以当前固件能读取的存档格式为准。

更新与恢复
更新前请先保存 .pksave。社区完整安装会覆盖原存档区域，安装新版后用备份恢复。已安装 PokeWalk 且布局一致的设备，也可从 https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/releases/latest 下载 PokeWalk-update.zip，按包内 README 用 USB 更新；该工具先备份再更新，不可作为社区安装固件上传。
网页只有在本次文件与重启后的结果一致时才确认导入完成；如果仍在等待或报错，请保留原备份并核对设备进度。新地图及 V20 迁移需要升级设备固件，单独刷新网页不能获得游戏新内容。

新地区与主题秘境
探索 → 路线中只列出已经开放的地区：彩虹徽章开放双子海岛和野生原野；粉红徽章开放幽灵高塔；金色徽章开放磁轨矿坑；深红徽章开放火山遗迹；绿色徽章开放龙息山谷。战胜冠军开放无人研究所，再完成一份新地区研究开放白银雪岭。完成八份新地区研究后开放冠军远征。
进入新地图选择「探索」，再选一条方向，消耗 5 点体能。发现五种当地伙伴后，在「活动」切换深层调查；深层同样消耗 5 点。研究要求发现五种、捕获三种、完成一次目标追踪并通关当地秘境；已有图鉴计入，可在活动页查看和领取一次性奖励。
从「活动」进入当地秘境，或在「秘境 → 选择主题」切换。新开局选自己的 1～3 只伙伴，消耗 20 点体能；继续不重复扣费。当地首通后可选挑战档。通关后选择寻找伙伴的方向，再回「遭遇」捕获。新主题奖励遇到满遭遇或满背包会暂存，不替换旧遭遇；在秘境入口领取，或经过二次确认后放弃，再开始下一局。旧森林的奖励规则保持。
本次使用 V20 存档，并迁移旧秘境记录；当前网页及 10 月 5 日修复后的离线工具可直接处理，无需手改备份。更早工具仍需刷新或重新下载。

探索方向与等级
新地区共有 24 条栖息地路线，方向页显示代表伙伴和常规/深层的实际等级范围。例如双子海岛分为贝壳滩、冰洞口、深海潮道，三处伙伴池不同；全地区共享追踪线索，追踪目标或保底可能跨越所选方向。普通探索等级：双子海岛 35–45、幽灵高塔 42–55、野生原野 38–50、磁轨矿坑 45–58、火山遗迹 48–60、龙息山谷 50–65、无人研究所 60–75、白银雪岭 65–85。深层调查使用对应区间的较高一半。
这些新地图的遭遇等级不再跟随首发等级，生成后固定，换首发或重启不会重抽。原四条路线仍按伙伴等级适配；已存在的遭遇保留原等级。选择光标或取消不扣体能，确认方向后才消耗 5 点。


轮换、照料与连携
探索分支页显示两种当前访客，同一地区每探索 12 次轮换。照料页选择「养成效果」可查经验、特殊发现与捕获加成。地图或徽章活动的野生胜利累计连携；确认捕获或探索战败清零，其他模式不影响。有连携时捕获默认取消，用 A/B 选择后 C 确认。菜单和照料名字附近显示累计亮屏游戏时长。
完整官网攻略：https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/guide/
instructions_en:
Start your adventure
Follow Professor Oak and choose Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle or Pikachu. Existing saves resume automatically. The game works offline without Wi-Fi setup.

Controls
A moves up, B down, C confirms. Hold B to return; hold C to sleep. Idle sleep starts after about 60 seconds. Any function key wakes the screen; the wake press does not activate a menu. For capture, A/B change balls and C throws when the moving marker is inside the blue window. Follow on-screen prompts.

First steps
From Home choose Care, Menu or Encounters. Menu contains Pokédex, Party, Items, Care, Challenges, Options, Achievements, Exploration and Dungeon. Begin with Exploration, select a route and find a partner, then capture or battle. Battles choose learned moves automatically, without PP. When a partner meets evolution requirements, put it first and select Care > Evolution.

Care, stamina and playtime
Feed a berry for satiety; playing costs 5 stamina and is unavailable below that amount. Feeding remains available. Care Benefits explains XP, special-event and capture-window bonuses. Shared stamina caps at 100 and refills in about an hour. Exploration and route trainers cost 5, Gym/rematch/Red challenges cost 10, and an Elite Four plus Champion run costs 20 once. New dungeon runs cost 20; continuing costs no additional entry fee. Menu and Care show cumulative screen-on playtime across restarts. Older unrecorded time cannot be reconstructed.

Regions and dungeons
Rainbow Badge opens Twin Islands and Safari Fields; Soul opens Ghost Tower; Marsh opens Magnetic Mine; Volcano opens Volcanic Ruins; Earth opens Dragon Valley. Defeating the Champion opens Abandoned Lab, then one completed regional study opens Silver Snow Ridge. Eight completed studies unlock Champion Expedition.
Choose Exploration in a new region, then a habitat trail; only confirming spends 5 stamina. Regional level bands are Twin Islands 35–45, Ghost Tower 42–55, Safari Fields 38–50, Magnetic Mine 45–58, Volcanic Ruins 48–60, Dragon Valley 50–65, Abandoned Lab 60–75 and Silver Snow Ridge 65–85. Deep exploration uses the upper half after five local species are discovered. Original routes still scale to your partner. Existing encounters do not reroll when you switch partners or restart.
Trails show two visitors, rotating every 12 explorations of that region. Regional clues are shared, so tracked/guaranteed encounters may use another trail. Regional studies require five discoveries, three captures, a completed tracking target and the local dungeon clear. Claim their one-time rewards in Activities.
Enter local dungeons through Activities or choose a theme in the Dungeon lobby. Select 1–3 of your own partners. HP and status persist between nodes; choose upgrades, rest at camps and defeat the boss. Local first clears unlock a harder mode. After a new-theme clear, select a direction to find a rare capturable partner, then capture it from Encounters. If a new-theme reward cannot fit, collect it later in the lobby or discard after confirmation before starting another run. The original Forest reward enters the five-slot encounter list, replacing its oldest entry if full. Settled rewards remain after defeat or retirement.

Exploration chains
Wild wins from map exploration or badge activities build a shiny chain for future encounters. Changing pages/regions, restarting or playing other battle modes preserves it. Losing an exploration battle or confirming capture resets it. With a chain, capture opens a second confirmation defaulting to Cancel; use A/B and C. Cancelling spends no ball and preserves the chain. Escaping does not add or reset it.

Items and achievements
Claims are allowed when stacks are full; rewards fill remaining capacity and excess is not added. Higher-rarity wild opponents drop better balls and evolution items more often. Trainer matches and exploration clues provide food. In trainer/Gym/league battles, Tactics > Milk heals at least 50 HP or half maximum HP (rounded up), whichever is higher, capped at full HP, and clears status. It uses one turn and cannot revive a fainted partner.

Options
Toggle mute and battery display, or press C to adjust volume/brightness with A/B and finish with C. Brightness ranges from 10% to 100%. Raising volume does not unmute. Battery appears beside the partner name in Menu and Care. Settings persist after restart.

Wi-Fi time and offline stamina
Open Options > Wi-Fi Time and press C to start setup. Connect a phone to the PW- hotspot and password shown on the device, staying connected despite the no-internet warning. Open http://192.168.4.1 and enter an available 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network or a second device's hotspot, then select Connect and Save. The device shows Time Synchronized on success. Setup closes after about five minutes; C toggles it and holding B leaves it. Retry with corrected details if needed; outside setup, A retries time sync. Successful credentials are stored for the next boot. Initial sync establishes the time reference, and a later boot sync credits time spent powered off. Offline play remains available.

Backup, update and restore
Use desktop Chrome/Edge at https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/, choose a private backup folder, connect USB and authorize the serial port. Close competing serial tools. On the device select Options > Back Up Save and C. Wait for the website to save and read back the file and the device to confirm. Files stay on your computer.
To restore, open Options > Import Save, select a .pksave in the website and request import. The device defaults to Cancel; explicitly select overwrite and confirm. Your current save is backed up first, then import and restart proceed. Reconnect and verify the result and your progress. V5–V19 migrate to V20; V20 can round-trip. Same-device identity and a matching layout are still required. Different build hashes alone do not block import. Do not edit backups or import V20 into older unsupported firmware. The developer restore.py command still requires the same build; use the website for cross-version restore.
Back up before updating. Full community installation overwrites the old save area, so import afterwards. Existing devices with matching layouts can use PokeWalk-update.zip from https://github.com/Luobata/ESP32-PokemonGo/releases/latest over USB, following its README. Do not submit the update ZIP as a community installation image.
New gameplay requires new firmware; refreshing the website alone is insufficient. Refresh for the latest guide, or download a new offline ZIP. Run python3 server.py (Windows: py -3 server.py) with Python 3.8+ and open http://localhost:8767/. Retain original backup files if restore is still waiting or reports a problem.

Complete game guide: https://luobata.github.io/ESP32-PokemonGo/guide/
changelog_zh: 恢复皮卡丘对战暴鲤龙的原宣传封面。其余游戏内容与 10 月 6 日探索更新一致，固件文件及存档格式均未改变，无需重新烧录。
changelog_en: Restore the original Pikachu-versus-Gyarados cover. Gameplay remains the October 6 exploration release; firmware bytes and save formats are unchanged. No reflashing is needed.
